thread:
maya: Heads-up — I'm assembling the product announcement copy for the upcoming model rollout (deploy on Tue). Need final pass on the public changelog paragraph, known-issues, and two sample SDK snippets. Draft is at https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/842 :eyes:

sam: Looking now. Is the short blurb about 'auto-kv caching' okay? I reworded for clarity.

maya: pinging @priya for product wording. Also adding a short migration note for Dedicated customers.

priya: I can take copy for the announcement intro. Suggest we emphasize latency and cost controls.

jordan: SDK snippets — I tried a streaming JS example. Quick paste:
```
const r = await redwood.generateStream({ model: 'kestrel-13b', prompt: 'Summarize the API changes' });
for await (const chunk of r) console.log(chunk.text);
```
Use for docs if it matches runtime semantics.

maya: Nice. Can someone sanity-check the pagination/embedding known issue? I put: 'embedding order can differ after bulk-upsert; we recommend storing vector ids client-side.'

luis: That's accurate. Add a short workaround: 'reindex with stable ids' and link to the Migration Guide (needs actual link).

sam: Found a broken anchor: docs/guide/embeddings#bulk-upsert -> 404. I'll open a small redirect PR.

maya: thanks. Also small ask: we need two 1-line callouts for the changelog UI: 'improved model routing' and 'retry fallback on OOM'. Keep them under 75 chars.

priya: Proposed lines:
- 'Smarter routing reduces tail latency for mixed workloads.'
- 'Automatic model fallback on memory pressure to avoid failures.'

jordan: +1 to both. I trimmed the second to 'Automatic fallback on memory pressure.'

maya: Can anyone run a quick local deploy preview and confirm the anchor to the SDK snippet renders? Use `make preview-docs` and look at /whats-new.

sam: doing it now. Will report in 10.

ci-bot: CI check passed on docs PR #842 — all links validated: 22 passed, 1 warning.

sam: preview looks good except the code block copy has smart quotes from a paste. I fixed in a force-push.

maya: sweet. Last things: signoff by EOD so marketing can schedule the email. If you can't review, react :eyes: and I'll assume acceptance.

priya: Signed off. :thumbsup:

jordan: Small nit: add a note to migration guide about quantization profile bump for Dedicated. I'll add a commit.

luis: I'll add the redirect PR for the embedding anchor.

maya: Thanks team. I'll merge once luis and jordan land their two tiny follow-ups. Final ETA 18:00 PT.

sam: noted.

maya: (bot) publishing checklist: update changelog index, add whats-new banner, draft marketing blurb.

priya: I'll write the marketing blurb and attach here before EOD.

maya: done — created the merged PR and will do a post-merge announcement thread. :party:
